notes:
{床面|ゆかめん} is a technical compound of ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ (floor) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface). Used in construction, architecture, and facility management contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床面|ゆかめん}{積|せき}: floor area
- {床面|ゆかめん}⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧: floor finish
- {床面|ゆかめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧: floor surface cleaning
- {床面|ゆかめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め→滑り止め：27612_suberidome⟧: floor anti-slip treatment

VS. {床|ゆか}:
In everyday conversation, ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ is the normal word for "floor." {床面|ゆかめん} is used when specifically discussing the surface properties, materials, or measurements of flooring.

REGISTER:
Technical/written. Common in building specifications, safety regulations, and cleaning industry documentation.
